parsed.name: 串口通信组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于封装串口连接的启动、停止、缓冲区清理，以及按字节、字符串或整行进行读写。它主要用于实验系统与外部仪器、控制器或微控制器之间的串行数据交换，并提供异常处理以及字节与字符串之间的编码/解码支持。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component that wraps serial port connection start/stop, buffer clearing, and byte-, string-, or line-based read/write operations. It is used to exchange serial data between a lab system and external instruments, controllers, or microcontrollers, while providing exception handling and byte/string encoding-decoding support.
